stops.name: Gollinger Wasserfall
stops.detail: The Golling Waterfall, actually two consecutive waterfalls, is located on the eastern slope of the Göll massif, on the left side of the Salzach Valley on the Nikolausberg above the pilgrimage church.

stops.name: Naturbrücke
stops.detail: The upper stage is spanned by a natural bridge.
